title: Secondary lockup
slide_intent: Teach designers to identify an internal program economically. A familiar symbol and a clearly drawn name can help employees distinguish one initiative from another.
strategic_value: Slack can give internal programs a family resemblance while letting each program name lead the reading.
demonstration: The colored octothorpe appears directly beside the word “secondary.” A second example repeats the arrangement with guides for the spacing unit.
practical_value: For an employee-facing tool, event or group, use the symbol with the lowercase entity name and follow the diagrammed A-unit separation.

content_islands.name: Clean internal signature
